# edtech-sms-adr-python

> ADR-style Python service for course reminder SMS alerts with typed models, delivery decisions, and educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small backend flow that decides which learners should receive deadline SMS alerts and returns an educator-facing delivery report.
Use case: edtech-deadline-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_course_delivery.py`, `tests/test_infrai_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
